status_error_alert: Error detected in last verification. Check the logs for details.
status_empty_desc: Add an anime from the Add anime screen, or configure an Anilist account and run a check.
config_missing_banner: There are missing configurations — please fill them in to continue.
config_hint_anilist_usernames: Anilist accounts to track. Optional — you can also add animes one by one from the Add anime screen.
config_hint_download_statuses: AniList statuses to download anime from
config_hint_download_media_statuses: Anime airing statuses eligible for download
config_hint_delete_statuses: AniList statuses that trigger deletion of downloaded episodes
config_hint_completed_path: Your Jellyfin library. Completed episodes are hardlinked here, and in-progress downloads live in a hidden .torrents folder inside it.
config_hint_watched_keep: Set to 0 to delete all watched episodes
config_hint_max_concurrent: Torrents beyond this limit wait in the queue. Set to 0 for no limit; seeding is never limited.
config_label_rename_jellyfin: Rename files to a standard format (useful for Plex/Jellyfin)
config_hint_rename_jellyfin: Renames episode files to "Anime Name - E05.mkv", including the ones inside batch packs, for better metadata matching
config_hint_excluded_list: Lists that should not be downloaded
config_val_interval: Check interval must be greater than 0
config_hint_max_episodes: How many episodes of one anime exist at the same time. Applies to the episode-by-episode path only — a pack is a single torrent, so limiting records would not limit bytes. Set to 0 for no limit (a pack search then covers every pending episode at once).
config_val_max_episodes: Max episodes per anime must be non-negative
config_val_retry: Episode retry limit must be non-negative
config_val_max_concurrent: Max concurrent downloads must be non-negative
config_val_watched_keep: Watched episodes to keep must be non-negative
logs_empty_filtered: No logs match the current filters.
detail_empty: No episodes found for this anime.
detail_confirm_msg: Episode {number} will be removed from tracking. This action cannot be undone.
detail_bulk_confirm_msg: {count} episode(s) will be removed. This action cannot be undone.
detail_replace_invalid_magnet: Please enter a valid magnet link
detail_redownload_confirm_msg: Episode {number} will be deleted and searched again on Nyaa.
notifications_subtitle: Configure webhook integrations for download notifications
notifications_hint_batch_window: Groups the events of the same window into a single webhook. Use 0 to disable and send one per event. Useful with rate-limited services (e.g. ntfy.sh) — a library backfill can fire dozens of notifications at once.
downloads_subtitle: Live progress of the embedded torrent client
downloads_empty_desc: Torrents appear here while they download and keep seeding after they finish.
downloads_bulk_none: No selected torrent needed this action
downloads_empty_filtered_desc: Try a different search term or clear the status filter.
downloads_delete_consequence_blocked: This episode will not be downloaded again.
downloads_delete_consequence_blocked_ani: This anime's episodes will not be downloaded again.
downloads_delete_consequence_untracked: The anime leaves the standalone list and will not be downloaded again.
downloads_delete_consequence_will_redown: Warning: without this option, the daemon may download this episode again on its next pass, since the record will still exist without a matching torrent.
detail_progress_hint: Manual progress for a standalone anime. Raising it deletes what is behind it (respecting "watched episodes to keep" outside a pack, and the whole pack inside one). With "delete watched episodes" off nothing is deleted and no new pack is fetched.
downloads_ws_banner: No connection to the daemon — the progress below may be out of date
config_hint_max_batch_size: Pack torrents above this size are discarded from the search results. This is the only ceiling on packs: ~40 GiB fits a 26-episode 1080p pack, and the 100 GiB default deliberately does not fit a full One Piece pack (a partial pack does). Set to 0 for no limit.
config_hint_max_episode_size: Single-episode torrents above this size are discarded from the search results (~1.5 GiB for a 1080p episode). Set to 0 for no limit.
config_hint_max_search_pages: Ceiling on Nyaa result pages per search. A search only goes to the next page while it has few accepted candidates, so this is a limit and not a fixed cost — most searches still read a single page.
config_hint_min_seeders: Torrents with fewer seeders than this are discarded from the search results. The default of 1 only blocks dead torrents, which otherwise get picked when they are the only candidate. Set to 0 for no floor.
config_hint_min_free_disk: Below this percentage of free space downloads are paused. Set to 0 to disable the guard.
config_val_torrent_size: Torrent size limits must be non-negative
config_val_max_search_pages: Max search pages must be non-negative
config_val_min_free_disk: Min free disk space must be between 0 and 99
add_subtitle: Search AniList and track an anime that is not in your lists.
add_no_results: No anime found for this search.
add_library_required: Configure the library before adding animes.
add_toast_tracked_no_episodes: Now tracking — no episode available yet
block_library_not_configured: Configure the library before adding animes.
detail_untrack_msg: It will no longer be checked for new episodes.
lastcheck_all_above_size_limit: {candidates} torrents found, all above the {limit} GB ceiling.
lastcheck_no_seeders: {candidates} torrents found, none with at least {seeders} seeders.
lastcheck_torrent_rejected: The torrent client rejected all {candidates} magnets.
lastcheck_max_episodes_per_anime: Per-anime limit reached: {downloaded} downloaded, {pending} still waiting.
lastcheck_batch_no_result: No batch torrent was found for this anime.
lastcheck_batch_above_size_limit: A batch was found but it is above the batch size ceiling.
lastcheck_batch_no_coverage: The batches found do not cover the pending episodes.
detail_lastcheck_notice: The last verification could not download episodes of this anime.
detail_lastcheck_episode_note: not downloaded in the last check
onboarding_step_source_hint: Your whole AniList list, or one anime at a time.
onboarding_step_check_hint: Every {minutes} min the daemon downloads what's missing. Nothing else to do.
onboarding_restore_hint: The intro card on the Status screen.
banner_backend_unreachable: No connection to the daemon. Check that it is running — this screen will not update until it is back.
banner_backend_error: The daemon responded with an error. This is an app bug; the data on screen may be incomplete.
banner_anilist_outage: AniList is down right now — nothing on your end. Your list may look out of date until it's back; the daemon will resume downloading on its own.
banner_anilist_rate_limited: AniList rate limit reached. Back to normal in {seconds}s.
banner_anilist_rate_limited_no_eta: AniList rate limit reached. Back to normal in about a minute.
banner_anilist_app_bug: The app is sending a query AniList no longer accepts. Update the app; if you are already on the latest version, please report it.
passerror_anilist: The last check did not run because AniList did not respond. It retries on its own next cycle.
passerror_setup: The last check did not run because the library folder is not configured yet.
passerror_library: The last check did not run because the library folder does not support hardlinks. Pick a folder on the same disk as the downloads.
passerror_torrent_backend: The last check did not run because the torrent client failed to start. Restart the app.
passerror_config: The last check did not run because the configuration could not be read.
passerror_storage: The last check did not run because the app's data could not be read.
passerror_unknown: The last check did not finish.
files_toggle: Show or hide the files of {name}
